title: The Candle Flame Twin in the Window
youtube_title: The Candle Flame Twin in the Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Kito finds a candle and its twin in the dark window. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kito shows Golda how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
